texts.banner: Research prototype, not a medical device. Please do not upload photos of other people.
texts.disclaimer: This tool shows what an image model noticed in the photo. It can be wrong, it cannot rule out any condition, and it is not medical advice.
texts.see_dentist: Please see a dentist about anything that worries you, whatever this tool shows.
texts.urgency.routine: Demo hint: nothing here points to an urgent visit, but regular check-ups are always sensible.
texts.urgency.soon: Demo hint: consider booking a visit with a dentist soon.
texts.urgency.prompt: Demo hint: consider contacting a dentist promptly.
texts.urgency.retake_photo: The photo could not be used. Please retake it in good light with the teeth in focus.
texts.finding.caries.possible: A region that may show tooth decay (caries) was noticed. This tool cannot rule out other causes.
texts.finding.caries.not_seen: No region resembling caries was noticed. This does not rule out caries.
texts.finding.filling.possible: A region that may be a filling was noticed.
texts.finding.crown.possible: A region that may be a crown was noticed.
texts.finding.abrasion.possible: A region that may show a worn tooth surface (abrasion) was noticed.
texts.finding.abrasion.not_seen: No worn surface was noticed. This does not rule out wear.
texts.finding.gingivitis.possible: Gums that may look inflamed (possible gingivitis) were noticed. This tool cannot rule out other causes.
texts.finding.gingivitis.not_seen: No inflamed-looking gums were noticed. This does not rule out gum problems.
texts.finding.periapical_lesion.possible: An area that may be a lesion at a tooth root was noticed on the X-ray.
texts.finding.periapical_lesion.not_seen: No root lesion was noticed. This does not rule one out.
texts.finding.impacted_tooth.possible: A tooth that may be impacted was noticed on the X-ray.
texts.finding.impacted_tooth.not_seen: No impacted tooth was noticed. This does not rule one out.
texts.not_assessed.none: Everything this tool can look for was assessed. It cannot look for everything.
texts.not_assessed.unusable: Nothing was assessed because the photo could not be used.
texts.quality.no_teeth: No teeth are visible in the photo.
texts.quality.not_dental: This does not look like a photo of teeth.
texts.estimate_footer: All prices are illustrative estimates, not quotes. Flight estimates come from a model calibrated on US domestic fares; its error on international routes has not been measured.
texts.ai_disclosure.title: AI voice and translation
texts.ai_disclosure.body: This call uses an AI-generated voice and machine translation. Translations can be wrong, especially for doses, allergies and numbers. It is not a certified medical interpreter.
texts.consent.photo_analysis.v1: I agree that my photo is processed to show image observations. A photo of teeth can reveal health information. It is not stored and is deleted after processing.
texts.consent.share_with_clinic.v1: I agree to share the image observations from this analysis, without the photo, with the clinic I book. They are deleted 24 hours after my appointment.
texts.call.captions_only: Audio translation is off. Captions only.
texts.call.pair_unverified: This language pair has not been verified. Translation quality may be lower.
